evidence.reason: The finding identified a stdout narration leak in scripts/ratchet-typecheck.mjs. The supplied history contains a later fixing commit, f567715e7c85c764cdc7c01f75e7052c4d97dbe0 ("fix(scripts): address crq triage findings in eval, ratchet and probe scripts"), which addresses triage findings in the ratchet scripts, including this kind of output-routing issue. The current contract and script comments still require human narration on stderr, so the underlying concern was valid when raised, but it has been fixed at the pinned tip.
